title: Slam 'n Jam '96 featuring Magic & Kareem: Signature Edition
overview:
It's Showtime!

Track team, game and league leaders' stats. Up to four players. View instant replays from multiple angles.

Slam 'n Jam '96 is a five-on-five basketball game played in 3D from a courtside camera behind the baseline, endorsed by Magic Johnson and Kareem Abdul-Jabbar. Choose from city teams, national squads from Europe and Asia, and all-star line-ups including Magic & Kareem's All-Stars, then take them through a single game, a full season or the playoffs. Fatigue, timeouts, substitutions and foul calls are all part of the game, with adjustable quarter lengths.

- Exhibition, Season and Playoffs modes
- Play-by-play commentary
- Up to 4 players with a multiplayer adaptor
- Memory backup
